purpose: Freeze the model-artifact transfer journeys used by io_transfer v1 P1 before the only candidate measurement bundle.

common_semantics.destination: one existing sibling destination remains intact until a complete temporary artifact is synced, closed and atomically renamed over it
common_semantics.memory: one 1 MiB transfer buffer and O(1) memory in artifact size
common_semantics.failure: any short read/write, metadata, validator, extent, checksum, sync, close or publication failure invalidates the process
common_semantics.interpretation: the formal peer is source-pinned libcurl 8.22.0 through its public easy API; an earlier direct POSIX same-task route was used only to locate completion amortization and cannot support a public peer, primitive or library-wide SOTA claim

workloads.consumer: an inference process prepares a complete local model artifact before making it visible to loaders
workloads.source: one 256 MiB sparse regular file on the same local filesystem as the destination
charged_phases: source open, initial metadata validation and complete positioned reads
incremental FNV-1a verification and complete positioned temporary-file writes
file data-and-metadata sync, close and atomic replacement of an existing destination

workloads.consumer: a model download requests cancellation after reaching 32 MiB and resumes the retained artifact without downloading the prefix again
workloads.source: one identity-encoded 64 MiB loopback HTTP/1 representation with a strong ETag
charged_phases: initial GET, response validation and cancellation after the first completed body chunk at or beyond 32 MiB
connection interruption and retained partial ownership
second connection with Range and If-Range
bounded suffix write from the actual retained offset, file sync, close and atomic replacement

negative_space: source creation, server construction and persistent runtime construction are outside timing
repository schemas, authentication, archive extraction and model parsing are not transfer-factor work
raw file copy without checksum, source-identity validation, sync and atomic publication is not an admissible primary comparator
a second full GET instead of validated Range resume is not an admissible holdout comparator
